Node.description: Base node without a position: logic, scripts, grouping.

Node3D.description: Empty object in 3D space: an anchor point for child nodes.

Camera3D.description: Perspective camera. Cameras draw in order, the first one is the main.

Component.description: Base of all components. A disabled component takes no part in the game.

SceneSystem.description: Base of all scene systems: physics, audio, rendering.

TransformSystem3D.description: Keeps world matrices of 3D nodes up to date in one pass over the changed ones.

RenderSystem.description: Keeps the cameras of the scene and their order of drawing; the first one is the main camera.

MeshRenderer.description: Draws a mesh at the position of its Node3D.

Transform3D.description: Position, rotation and scale relative to the parent node.

GeneralSettings.description: General information about the game: name, version, company, startup scene

SettingsSection.description: Base of every project settings section.

TimeSettings.description: Game time: the fixed physics step and the longest frame.

LayerSettings.description: Names of the 32 node layers used by camera masks and physics.

ExecutionOrderSettings.description: Order of component types inside the frame phases, overrides the order from code.

GraphicsSettings.description: Graphics API per system and vsync. Changing the API rebuilds only the renderer, no restart.

ScriptsSettings.description: Building the game module from the scripts/ folder: Debug or Release.

InputSettings.description: Input actions and their bindings to keys and mouse buttons. Scripts ask for an action by name, not for a key.

Script.description: Base of C++ scripts: game behaviour with the component lifecycle.
